profile.headline: Software Engineer at WebstaurantStore | C#/.NET · Blazor · React | Warehouse Management Systems & Automation
profile.summary:
Software engineer with 5 years of experience building warehouse management systems for high-volume e-commerce distribution. At WebstaurantStore, I develop and maintain a WMS that processes ~50,000 order lines per day per warehouse across the company's distribution network, using C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Blazor, and React.

Highlights:
• Led development of an automated case-routing system integrating with Fortna RealTime Controls (FRC) over ActiveMQ, using a directed-graph model to route cases across warehouse conveyor networks.
• Built order-consolidation (putwall) workflows that merge items from multiple warehouse zones into a single cubby per order.
• Helped stand up 5 new fully automated warehouses, including select sites on Fortna's Warehouse Execution System (WES) layer; currently converting the company's first legacy, manually operated warehouse to automated workflows.
• Design normalized schemas and optimize complex queries in Microsoft SQL Server with Entity Framework Core and Dapper.
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps; mentor an intern engineer; collaborate directly with product owners and stakeholders in an Agile environment.
• Use AI-assisted developer tools — GitHub Copilot and Claude Code — daily to accelerate development, testing, and code review.

Looking for senior software engineer roles, with an emphasis on warehouse automation and systems integration.

Authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain a warehouse management system used at the company's distribution network, using C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core RESTful APIs, and Blazor and React frontends.
• Led development of an automated case-routing system integrating with Fortna RealTime Controls (FRC) over ActiveMQ messaging, implementing a directed-graph model to route cases across warehouse conveyor networks.
• Built order-consolidation (putwall) workflows that merge items arriving from multiple zones of the warehouse into a single cubby per order, enabling accurate, efficient multi-item order fulfillment.
• Helped stand up 5 new fully automated warehouses integrating the WMS with FRC, including select sites on Fortna's Warehouse Execution System (WES) layer; currently converting the company's first legacy, manually operated warehouse to automated workflows.
• Design normalized schemas and write and optimize complex queries in Microsoft SQL Server using Entity Framework Core and Dapper.
• Maintain CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps supporting automated builds, testing, and deployments.
• Mentor an intern engineer through code reviews, pairing, and coaching on development standards and best practices.
• Collaborate directly with product owners and business stakeholders to define business rules and translate requirements into secure, high-quality technical solutions in an Agile environment.
• Use AI-assisted developer tools — GitHub Copilot and Claude Code — daily to accelerate development, testing, and code review.
